en.headline: Hong Kong gold clearing company names first chief executive
en.dek: Chan Ping-keung will take up a three-year term on 2 October at the government-owned firm building a central gold clearing system due to open in the first quarter of 2027.
body: Hong Kong Precious Metals Clearing Limited said on Monday it had appointed Chan Ping-keung as its first chief executive for a three-year term, with the former Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing executive due to take up the post on 2 October.

The government-owned company was set up to build and run a central gold clearing and settlement system for over-the-counter trades. The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau said the system is scheduled to begin operation in the first quarter of next year.

A selection committee recommended Chan after a global open recruitment, and the board approved the appointment. The company said he would work with refiners, banks and other market participants to develop an internationally aligned gold trading ecosystem in Hong Kong.

Board chairman and Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said the national 15th Five-Year Plan supports Hong Kong in building a commodities trading ecosystem, and that gold is the city’s chosen entry point. He said Chan has experience in financial markets, market infrastructure and government work.

Chan served as an Administrative Officer from 1988 to 2000, including as principal assistant secretary for financial services on securities and derivatives policy and the listing of HKEX. He later joined the exchange and rose to managing director and co-head of cash equity, fixed income and currency businesses in the global markets division.

zh.headline: 港金結算公司任命陳秉强為首任行政總裁
zh.dek: 前港交所高層陳秉强將於10月2日履新，任期三年，負責籌備明年首季啟用的黃金中央清算及結算系統。
body: 香港貴金屬中央結算系統有限公司周一宣布，任命陳秉强為首任行政總裁，任期三年，並於10月2日履新。
港金結算公司由政府全資擁有，負責籌建及營運香港黃金中央清算及結算系統，為場外黃金交易提供清算及結算服務。財經事務及庫務局表示，系統預計明年首季正式啟用。
任命由選選委員會按全球公開招聘結果向董事會推薦，並獲董事會批准。公司指陳秉强將與精煉商、金融機構等產業鏈上下游合作，推動構建達國際標準的香港黃金交易生態圈。
董事會主席、財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇表示，國家「十五五」規劃綱要支持香港構建大宗商品交易生態圈，本港亦以黃金作為發展切入點。他指陳秉强對金融市場、市場基礎設施及政府運作均有經驗。
陳秉强於1988年至2000年任職政務主任，曾任財經事務局首席助理秘書長，負責證券及衍生工具市場政策與港交所合併上市等工作。他其後加入港交所，升任董事總經理兼環球市場科股本證券與定息產品及貨幣業務聯席主管。
